svg.title: Yale Farm boundary review
svg.desc: Aerial and satellite images of the same area with assessor parcel outlines and a provisional public farm outline. The farm outline is not confirmed and is not a planted-area measurement.

g.text: Yale Farm: property, farm extent, and growing areas
345 Edwards Street, New Haven / Mill River watershed / boundary review needed
CT ECO: fine detail for reviewing field edges
Sentinel-2: 10-meter pixels; individual beds are not resolved
Property: parcel 14057, listed at 335 Prospect Street. The farm is only part of this property.
Farm extent: public outline measures 0.72 acres; Yale describes approximately 1 acre.
Growing areas: beds, tunnels, paths, and shared spaces still need separate mapping and team confirmation.
North is up. Both panels show the same geographic extent. Images are from different seasons and years.
Sources: CT GIS Office parcel service (records marked 2026), CT ECO 2023 aerial imagery, Copernicus Sentinel-2 via Earth Search.
Farm outline: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL, way 45092131 (last edit 2020). No drought or vegetation-change inference.
